subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A system of government by one person with absolute power
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"Autocracy"** refers to a system of government by one person with absolute power. (स्वेच्छाचारिता)

 
 
• **Example:** The country was ruled by an **autocracy** where the leader had unchecked control over all aspects of governance.
 
 
 
• **Autocracy** is characterized by the concentration of power in a single authority who makes decisions without any checks or balances. (स्वेच्छाचारिता)
 
 
• **Example:** The monarch's **autocracy **ensured that no one could challenge his decisions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Anarchy** (अराजकता): A state of disorder due to the absence or non-recognition of authority.

 
 
• **Example:** The collapse of the government led to a period of anarchy in the region.
 
 
 
• **Bureaucracy** (नौकरशाही): A system of government in which most of the important decisions are taken by state officials rather than by elected representatives.
 
 
• **Example:** The company's bureaucracy often slowed down decision-making processes.
 
 
 
• **Democracy** (लोकतंत्र): A system of government by the whole population, typically through elected representatives.
 
 
• **Example:** In a democracy, citizens have the right to vote and elect their leaders.
